lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately ten visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with higher spot density observed in the mid-lateral region than in the dorsal-most visible section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, most prominently in the central third of the visible flank, creating a grid-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms, including a large elongated high-luminance feature (remora) trailing ventral to the pectoral fin and a cluster of smaller low-luminance teleosts below the anterior mid-section.
